paragraphs: Psych Hub sells training and continuing education to behavioral health clinicians and to the organizations that employ them. The catalog runs past a hundred courses spanning the treatment methods, conditions and populations these clinicians work with day to day.

Finishing an eligible course generates a continuing education certificate. Those courses are accredited for continuing education across more than ten bodies. A separate beta tool lets a clinician hold a clinical conversation with an AI client and get feedback on technique against a rubric. Condition specific Clinical Care Pathway certifications are described as still in development rather than available.

Organizations get administrative tooling on top of the library, including assigning and tracking training, building their own branded courses, managing cohorts and roles, and reporting on outcomes. The provider organizations named as buyers are health systems, multi-state groups, CCBHCs and 1099 networks. Separate sections address health plans and payers. Courses are clinically reviewed by a team of licensed mental health experts before publication. An individual clinician can start free, with a paid tier listed at fifteen dollars per seat per month on an annual plan.
